notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone, long time no see! Trent here!
As many of you in the [url=https://discord.gg/tN8NkuPEfC]Official Discord[/url] know, we are heads-down working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2907890/Wizzerd_Quest_2/]Wizzerd Quest 2[/url] right now. But I wanted to take an opportunity to do one final, small feature update to the original game. Here's the catch though: I'm not gonna tell you what I've changed. I will only say this:

Something has been added to the game. Something ancient, something dark... Have a look around town.

Best of luck, and hope to see you in Evenfall Bay when Wizzerd Quest 2 launches on Steam and Itch.io later this year!

notes.title: Coming Soon: Wizzerd Quest 64!
notes.content:
[h1]Announcing Wizzerd Quest 64![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869449/33fa309c95e29b3a67ea23736769a2361bf3e76c.png[/img]
[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2907890/Wizzerd_Quest_64/]Available to Wishlist Now![/url][/b][/h2]
[h2][b]Your feedback and reviews have been heard![/b] Wizzerd Quest 64 is a brand-new game from Kondoorsoft, improving on the original Wizzerd Quest in every single way![/h2]

[previewyoutube=k7pgsNO4zl0;full][/previewyoutube]


You have returned from abroad to find your homeland overrun by the Rising Night, a necromancer cult proclaiming the name of your newly deceased emperor. With the kingdoms of the Evenfall Bay already at each others' throats, it is up to you to drive the necromancers out, region by region, and restore balance to the bay, before taking the fight to the Citadel of the Moon and destroying them for good.

Experience the iconic Wizzerd Quest writing and optional co-op gameplay paired with major enhancements, including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] A huge detailed open world to explore, broken into distinct regions, each with their own unique visual style
[*] A refreshed combat system that allows the player to handle encounters in many different ways
[*] A rich diversity of enemies with unique animations, smarter AI, and ranged abilities able to hit you from a distance
[*] A faction reputation system that affects how you are treated based on how you treat NPCs
[*] Joinable guilds, each with their own set of side quests, allowing the player to earn money in ways other than combat - but not all of them are the good guys...
[*] Inns and taverns where the player can kick back, relax and heal up in comfort
[*] Home ownership in regions where the townsfolk like you, allowing the player to become more than just a visitor - a homeowner!
[*] A ton more surprises on the horizon!
[/list]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2907890/Wizzerd_Quest_64/]Releasing this year! Wishlist today![/url][/b]
